verdictSemantics.PASS: the recipe's actions executed (execution count > 0) and every expected outcome was met against live observation. This attests the DECLARED CONSTRUCTION SCOPE only: the bounded actual-Comet core-transaction recovery slice on the real managed CLI (pre-commit kill → rollback recovery, post-commit kill → roll-forward recovery, same-operation dispatch recovery without duplicate dispatch, old-attempt replay refusal, lock-layer old-writer fencing, and Run/journal/approval/continuation readback) plus the recipe/registration coordination. It NEVER asserts the full V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY journey: the live Outline unknown-result window, independent external monitoring and backup qualification run at execution_owner=VERIFY after I07/I08/P4 mechanisms exist (execution-contract journey_execution; same-run-delivery.journey.json step 9). verdictSemantics.FAIL: the declared construction scope executed and the observed outcome contradicted the frozen THEN (a killed transaction did not recover to a consistent state, a replayed or old attempt was accepted, a duplicate receipt or duplicate dispatch appeared, the live old writer was not fenced, the dead writer's lock was not recovered, the recipe/registration binding drifted, or the case module reported failures)
verdictSemantics.NOT-EXERCISED: a prerequisite was missing (registered recipe, schema-valid definition, frozen pilot baseline, identity or environment — e.g. the patched Comet build d4370930 is absent, or a kill window could not be landed within the bounded attempt budget); structured refusal with nonzero exit, never converted into a pass
verdictSemantics.NOT-APPLICABLE: explicitly out of scope for the registered profile with a recorded reason; still nonzero; the runner never self-assigns it
